entries.en:
Electing to put your faith in Chaqurl Qhotl's argument, you express your support for his theory of Ronkan beneficence, a vote of confidence that pleases the Qitari child greatly. Grudgingly agreeing that his son may have a point, Qitarl Natl agrees to assist in the restoration of the first stela.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Under your watchful eye, the Qitari artisans restore the first stela to Chaqurl Qhotl's best interpretation of its former glory. Encouraged and heartened by reclaiming a vital piece of their legacy, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Continue to lend them your aid in their efforts should you so desire.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl célèbrent la restauration de leur stèle légendaire. Mais ce n'est qu'une première partie, les fouilles continuent encore afin de déterrer le passé de leur peuple !
entries.ja: ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、「第一の石碑」の復元完了を、とても喜んでいるようだ。これからも、キタリ族の発掘を手伝っていこう！

entries.en: Father may have his reasons for thinking as he does, but I choose to believe in a brighter version of history.
entries.fr: souuutenir théorie de Chaqurl Qhotl ?  aussi penser que Ronka protéger Qitari ?
entries.ja:
そるかしの考えた、ロンカ皇帝「キタリ族守護説」、
よいと思ってくださるでござうか？

entries.en: Yes, I am quite certain that the Ronkan emperor was a benevolent man who protected our ancestors from fearsome beasts and bestowed upon them a position of honor in their society. Surely you can agree?
entries.fr: Chaqurl Qhotl penser que stèle décrire première rencontre de Qitari et Ronka. Grand et fort empereur de Ronka protéger frêles Qitari avec grande épée, puis Qitari et peuple de Ronka devenir amis !
entries.ja:
「第一の石碑」は、初代皇帝とキタリの出会いの場面でござう。
皇帝は、弱～いキタリを魔物から剣で守ってくれて、
キタリ族と皇帝は、信頼しあったトモダチになったでござうよ！

entries.en: If you elect to vouch for Chaqurl Qhotl's theory, the first stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Qitarl Natl envisions it.
entries.fr: Si vous choisissez de soutenir la théorie de Chaqurl Qhotl, la stèle des Qitari sera restaurée selon cette hypothèse. Vous ne pourrez pas voir la version proposée par Qitarl Natl.
entries.ja:
「チャクルリ・コテル」の説を信じてストーリーを進行させると、
彼の説に基づき、石碑の復元が行われるようです。
「キタルリ・ナトル」の説での復元結果を見ることはできません。

entries.en: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
entries.fr: Les récompenses que vous obtiendrez seront les mêmes dans les deux cas. Suivez donc vos convictions pour faire ce choix.

なお、どちらを進行しても、得られるアイテムや、
今後のコンテンツ内容などに、変化はありません。
あなたが語られるべきと思う歴史を、選択してください。
